title: Sustained simvastatin delivery via poly(lactide) nanoparticles enhances early osteogenic-associated responses in human periodontal ligament stem cells
task: Improve cytocompatibility and osteogenic responses of simvastatin via nanoparticle delivery
key_results: Nanoparticle-delivered simvastatin enhanced mineralization and increased periostin/osteocalcin secretion by day 14 in hPDLSCs; maintained long-term proliferative capacity better than free simvastatin in osteoblasts
comments: While the nanoparticle formulation shows promise for early osteogenic enhancement, the convergence of mineralization outcomes by day 21 suggests limited sustained benefit over free drug, warranting longer-term studies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nanoparticle-mediated simvastatin delivery improves cytocompatibility and early osteogenic responses compared to free simvastatin
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: enhanced mineralization, periostin/osteocalcin secretion by day 14; improved long-term proliferative capacity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nanoparticles are efficiently internalized by hPDLSCs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: rhodamine-labeled nanoparticles showed efficient uptake with cytoplasmic localization

title: Longitudinal digital speech assessment in progressive supranuclear palsy
task: Develop digital speech biomarkers for monitoring disease progression in progressive supranuclear palsy
key_results: Longitudinal speech features captured disease trajectory over 12 months with sensitivity to severity changes; ML models accurately predicted concurrent and 3-month future clinical scores
comments: Small cohort (n=32) and single disease subtype (PSP-RS) limit generalizability; remote deployability is promising for clinical monitoring applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Digital speech measures reflect PSP-RS disease progression over 12 months
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; longitudinal speech features demonstrated sensitivity to changes in disease severity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Speech-derived features can predict clinical trajectories 3 months in advance
hypotheses.result: Supported; ML models accurately forecasted future clinical scores from baseline speech data

title: Meta-cluster driven ensemble learning with cluster-augmented features for explainable heart disease prediction
task: Develop interpretable ensemble learning model for heart disease prediction
key_results: Meta Cluster-Driven Ensemble Learning Engine achieved 90.22% accuracy, 91.26% F1-score, 93.77% AUC; Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirmed statistical superiority
comments: Two-tier stacking architecture with cluster-augmented features is sound, but evaluation relies on retrospective Kaggle/UCI datasets without independent prospective validation.

inputs: patient clinical features (combined heart disease dataset)
outputs: heart disease risk prediction with confidence scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cluster-augmented features and meta-features improve ensemble prediction accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MCDELE outperformed baseline models on accuracy, F1, precision, and AUC metrics

title: AI-driven multi-omics integration and virtual screening identify UFC1 as a druggable effector in chemotherapy-stressed colorectal cancer
task: Identify druggable targets in chemotherapy-resistant colorectal cancer via multi-omics integration
key_results: UFC1 identified as chemotherapy sensitivity determinant; lead compound AK968 showed ΔG = –25.07 kcal/mol binding affinity and synergistic enhancement of 5-fluorouracil efficacy with increased γ-H2AX foci
comments: Comprehensive pipeline from TCGA/GEO data through structure-based screening to in vitro validation, though clinical translation remains to be demonstrated.

outputs: UFC1 as key chemotherapy sensitivity gene

hypotheses.hypothesis: UFC1 expression correlates with chemotherapy sensitivity and DNA damage response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via single-cell transcriptomics and pathway correlation analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: AK968 binding to UFC1 enhances 5-fluorouracil efficacy in UFC1-dependent manner
hypotheses.result: Validated; synergistic effect observed with increased DNA damage accumulation

title: Adaptive navigation control of a bionic robotic fish in complex Karman vortex street flow fields using an LSTM-DDPG hybrid strategy
task: Autonomous adaptive navigation of bionic robotic fish in Karman vortex street flows via LSTM-DDPG
key_results: 88.3% task completion rate; 5.2 J/m energy consumption (45.3% reduction vs PID); robust control at Re = 500, 800, 1000
comments: Well-engineered hybrid RL approach with IB-LBM simulation; eliminates model dependency but computational cost of simulation not reported.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LSTM-DDPG hybrid balances temporal flow prediction with energy-efficient control better than PID/DQN/MPC
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Achieves 88.3% completion rate and 45.3% lower energy vs PID; outperforms DQN and MPC on stability

title: Multi-objective student nurse allocation problem during training using exact and hybrid heuristic–metaheuristic methods
task: Multi-objective optimization for student nurse clinical allocation scheduling
key_results: CH-NSGA-II achieves 30.9% reduction in total completion time vs manual schedule; outperforms randomized heuristic baseline on normalized hypervolume for larger instances
comments: Practical application with real-world validation; hybrid heuristic-metaheuristic approach is sensible but not methodologically novel.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Constructive heuristic guidance improves NSGA-II convergence and Pareto-front quality over random initialization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CH-NSGA-II achieves higher hypervolume than randomized baseline on larger instances

title: Secure electronic voting system based on blockchain with dilithium authentication and zero-knowledge proof verification
task: Post-quantum secure and privacy-preserving blockchain-based electronic voting
key_results: 408 transactions/second throughput, 2.18 s block finalization; Dilithium + zero-knowledge proofs prevent double voting and preserve voter anonymity
comments: Comprehensive cryptographic design addressing practical election requirements; performance benchmark is credible but permissioned blockchain limits generalizability.

model_io.model: Blockchain voting system (Dilithium + ZKP + Byzantine consensus)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dilithium external authentication + internal ZKP circuits achieve post-quantum security with privacy preservation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Framework prevents identity-to-vote linkage and reuses of nullifiers while maintaining throughput

title: Heterogeneous traffic flow theory fundamental diagram model considering vehicle queuing characteristics and lane changing behavior
task: Heterogeneous fundamental diagram modeling for CAV-HDV mixed traffic flow
key_results: CAV platoon density shifts FD upward and delays congestion; max platoon length 4→10 vehicles increases flow marginally (4306→4507 veh/h); lane-change spacing critical for capacity
comments: Theoretical contribution is sound but relies on Markov chain abstractions that may not capture realistic driver behavior heterogeneity.

model_io.model: Multi-Lane Multi-Vehicle Interaction Sensitivity Function (MLMVISF) with Markov chain vehicle ratios

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing CAV platoon density shifts FD upward by exploiting coordinated longitudinal dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Numerical experiments show upward FD shift and delayed congestion onset across wide parameter ranges

title: RT-DETR-based object detection and parameter extraction for wireless signal spectrograms
task: Modulation recognition and parameter extraction from spectrograms using object detection
key_results: RT-DETR outperforms YOLOv8/v10/v11 across SNR range −30 to 30 dB; achieves superior average precision, recall, and NRMSE for parameter extraction on nine modulation types
comments: Solid engineering application but limited novelty in detection architecture; domain-specific contribution lies mainly in STFT-to-DETR pipeline rather than algorithmic innovation.

model_io.model: RT-DETR with Transformer Intra-scale and CNN Cross-scale modules

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer-based feature interaction and CNN cross-scale fusion overcome local convolution limitations in noisy signals
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: RT-DETR reduces missed detections and false alarms vs YOLO variants

title: VLAN-aware hierarchical multi-agent protection framework for robust fault isolation and coordination in active distribution networks
task: Adaptive protection coordination in DG-rich distribution networks using multi-agent systems
key_results: VLAN-aware hierarchical MAS improves selectivity, coordination reliability, and resilience under bidirectional fault currents and dynamic reconfiguration on IEEE 39-bus system
comments: Well-motivated architecture for modern grids but proof-of-concept validation is limited to single benchmark; generalization to diverse topologies unclear.

model_io.model: Three-layer MAS (RAs, CA, SA) organized into SVLANs, GVLANs, DVLANs

hypotheses.hypothesis: VLAN-driven hierarchical organization enables localized decisions while preserving global coordination under dynamic topologies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: System achieves robust fault clearance with improved selectivity on test platform

title: An energy efficient reliable machine learning based fuzzy fault tolerant model with self-healing routing in wireless sensor networks
task: Fault-tolerant self-healing routing and intrusion detection in resource-constrained WSNs
key_results: 99.2% attack detection rate (trust threshold 0.50); 12–18% PDR improvement and 22–31% network lifespan increase vs LEACH/PEGASIS/TEEN/AODV/SEP
comments: Practical system combining LightGBM classification (97.4% acc) with Mamdani FIS and Dyna-Q self-healing; synthetic training data (200k samples) may not capture real deployment heterogeneity.

model_io.model: CWSN-AI v4.2: LightGBM + Mamdani FIS + TBIDS + Dyna-Q routing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid LightGBM-FIS architecture simultaneously optimizes fault classification and cluster structure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Achieves 97.4% classification accuracy and 99.2% intrusion detection rate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dyna-Q self-healing routing recovers from multi-episode faults without manual reconfiguration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Demonstrates 22–31% network lifespan extension over baseline protocols

title: An explainable machine learning framework linking ESG performance and supply chain resilience prediction: evidence from Chinese listed companies
task: ESG-resilience linkage prediction for supply chain resilience via explainable machine learning
key_results: XGBoost AUC = 0.868; Governance dominates E and S in ESG hierarchy; customer concentration exhibits U-shaped relationship; liquidity shows diminishing marginal predictive contribution
comments: Novel ex-ante resilience prediction framework with credible SHAP interpretation; Chinese A-share data 2010–2023 limits international applicability but findings on governance primacy are strategically valuable.

model_io.model: XGBoost classifier + SHAP interpretation on multiple ML baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Governance quality has strongest monotonic effect on resilience; E and S are latent reputational buffers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: SHAP analysis reveals Governance as primary predictor; E/S show nonlinear, secondary effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: Customer concentration exhibits U-shaped resilience relationship driven by strategic dependence vs vulnerability trade-off
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Nonlinear mechanism identified via SHAP; reveals optimal concentration levels

title: Universal Planckian dissipation in the strange metal state of the cuprates
task: Explain universal Planckian dissipation in cuprate strange metals across doping ranges
key_results: Universal 1/τ emerges when optical plasma frequency ω²_opt(p) scales linearly with hole doping p; reconciles universality with doping-dependent resistivity
comments: Elegant resolution of a long-standing puzzle, but relies on empirical linearity of ω²_opt(p) which should be further validated across materials.

model_io.model: Doped Mott insulator with Gutzwiller factor (Anderson proposal)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Universal Planckian 1/τ requires universal mechanism independent of doping
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via linear ω²_opt(p) scaling with doping

title: Period increase and amplitude modification in the kink oscillations of a small-scale EUV loop
task: Characterize period and amplitude growth in coronal kink oscillations of small-scale loops
key_results: First observation of simultaneous sub-minute period increase and amplitude growth in four episodic cycles; period rise attributed to density increase, abrupt resets suggest magnetic reconfiguration
comments: Novel observational constraints on coronal heating mechanisms, though limited field-of-view and perspective restrict causal mechanism identification.

model_io.model: Solar Orbiter/EUI observations + theoretical kink wave analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Period increase driven by rising density within flux tube
hypotheses.result: Supported by concurrent intensity increase and theoretical expectations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Amplitude growth driven by localized heating or energy injection
hypotheses.result: Plausible but unconfirmed due to observational constraints

hypotheses.hypothesis: Episodic resets caused by intermittent magnetic reconnection
hypotheses.result: Inferred from observed period/amplitude reset pattern

title: Phase reconstruction and causality in nano-FTIR signals based on the finite dipole model with Kramers–Kronig relations
task: Reconstruct near-field phase signals in nano-FTIR using Kramers–Kronig relations within Finite Dipole Model
key_results: FDM–KKR framework yields analytical amplitude–phase relations consistent with causality; successfully reconstructs normalized phase and amplitude from PMMA polymer spectra
comments: Solid theoretical framework bridging analytical modeling and experiments, but validation limited to single polymer material; broader applicability needs assessment.

model_io.model: Finite Dipole Model (FDM) with Kramers–Kronig relations (KKR)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phase signal in nano-FTIR can be reconstructed from amplitude via KKR within FDM approximation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; analytical amplitude–phase relations agree with simulated data and satisfy causality
